title: Daily Devotional #23
paragraphs: As I read Matthew Chapter 23, I am struck by the words of Jesus as he rebukes the Pharisees and teachers of the law for their hypocrisy and pride. He warns his followers not to follow their example, for they may lead others astray.

It is a sobering reminder that being a leader, especially a spiritual leader, comes with great responsibility. It is not enough to simply teach your followers the right things to do, but you must also model it in your own life.

Lord, I pray for humility in my own life. May I not become prideful or hypocritical in my actions and words. May I always seek to serve others and point them towards you, rather than seeking my own glory or recognition.

I am also reminded of the importance of being a servant leader. Jesus himself came not to be served, but to serve and give his life as a ransom for many. May I follow his example and always seek to serve those around me, rather than expecting them to serve me.

Finally, I am reminded of the importance of obedience. Jesus tells the Pharisees that they have neglected the more important matters of the law- justice, mercy, and faithfulness. May I always prioritize these things in my own life and seek to obey your commands, rather than just going through the motions.
Thank you for this reminder today, Lord. May I continue to grow in humility, servanthood, and obedience as I follow you.
